info.name: Time Tracker
info.summary: Track your working time with a timer, organise it by project, client and tag, and turn it into reports
info.description:
Time Tracker records how much time you spend on your work, right in your Nextcloud.
## Track time - **Timer:** type what you're working on and press Start. Resume any earlier entry with one click; its project and tags are reused. - **Manual entries:** add time you forgot to track, or edit start and end times later. - **Daily overview:** entries are grouped by day, with the start and end time of each entry and a total per day. Entries with the same name are grouped with a subtotal, and groups can be folded. - **Costs:** add a cost to any entry.
## Organise - **Projects and clients:** assign entries to projects, and projects to clients. Projects have a colour and can be archived. - **Tags:** categorise entries independently of projects and clients. - **Locked projects:** admins can limit a project to certain users and tags.
## Analyse - **Dashboard:** charts of time and cost per client and project. - **Reports:** group by project, client, user or entry, per day, week, month or year; filter by project and client; download as CSV or JSON. - **Timelines:** save a report as a timeline, download it as CSV or email it. Admins review timelines and mark them as approved or rejected. - **Goals:** set weekly or monthly hours for a project and see how much is done.
## On the go Track time from your phone with the [Time Tracker Android app](https://github.com/Martin-1997/nc-timetracker-android).
Questions, ideas or bugs? Have a look at the [issues on GitHub](https://github.com/mtierltd/timetracker/issues), maybe your topic is already being discussed, or open a new one.
